title: Window Cleaning Scheduling Software 2026: 5 Tools Compared
description: Recurring rounds, rain-day moves, routing and online booking in Jobber, Housecall Pro, QuoteIQ, BookingKoala and Squeegee. Prices checked Nov 2026.
h1: Window cleaning scheduling software: recurring rounds, rain days and routes
body:
Scheduling a window cleaning business is mostly repeat work: houses on an 8-, 12- or 26-week cycle, storefronts every week or month, and a pile of jobs to move every time it rains. This page compares five tools on just that: recurring visits, rescheduling, routing, crew assignment and customer self-booking. Every price and feature comes from the vendor's own pages, checked 2026-11-11, and anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. For the wider quoting-and-invoicing roundup see best window cleaning business software; for customer records and follow-ups see window cleaning CRM.

What to look for in window cleaning scheduling software

  • Recurring visits on your cycle: the tool should repeat a job automatically every N weeks, not just weekly or monthly.
  • Fast rain-day moves: drag-and-drop or bulk replanning, plus an automatic text so the customer knows the new date.
  • Routing: on a full day of houses, sequencing stops matters more than almost anything else. Check which plan includes it, because most vendors keep it off the entry tier.
  • Crew assignment: if you run two or more vans, you need to assign jobs to a person or team and have their phone update.
  • Self-booking: letting residential customers pick a slot online saves phone tag, but check whether it respects your service areas and crew availability.

1. Jobber: drag-and-drop calendar, routing from Connect

Jobber's window cleaning page lists a drag-and-drop calendar to reschedule or reassign jobs, map and routing to "generate the fastest, most fuel-efficient routes", GPS-based assignment of last-minute jobs to the closest technician, a progress timeline for each cleaner, and push notifications when you change someone's workday. Customers can book online and use request forms on every plan, and Jobber can charge a saved card automatically, which it pitches for recurring work.

The catch for scheduling is plan level: routing and GPS tracking start on Connect ($99/mo billed annually, $139/mo monthly, 1 user), not Core. Core is $29/mo billed annually ($39/mo with a 1-year commitment, $49/mo with no commitment). Connect also adds automated client reminders. A 5-user Connect plan is $149/mo billed annually, and extra users are $29/mo each. The trial is 14 days on Grow with no credit card. Full breakdown: Jobber pricing.

2. Housecall Pro: rain-delay rescheduling and repeat visits

Housecall Pro's window cleaning page has the most window-specific scheduling copy of the five: one calendar for every job, drag-and-drop, crew availability, weekly storefront cleans, monthly commercial visits or seasonal residential appointments set to repeat automatically, and the ability to "move rain-delayed cleaning jobs, update crew assignments, and notify customers" when details change. It also lists "On my way" texts and appointment reminders.

Basic ($59/mo billed annually, $79/mo monthly, 1 user) includes scheduling and dispatch and online booking from Google or your website. Essentials ($149/mo annually, $189/mo monthly, 5 users) adds Routes (group and sequence jobs to cut drive time) and employee GPS. MAX ($299/mo annually, $329/mo monthly, 8 users, $35/mo per extra user) adds one-click route optimization based on real drive time and live traffic, plus Recurring Service Plans for maintenance agreements. 14-day MAX trial, no credit card. More: Housecall Pro pricing.

3. QuoteIQ: recurring jobs and weather on every plan

QuoteIQ's plan table lists calendar and drag-and-drop scheduling, recurring jobs and built-in weather forecasts on every plan, including Essentials ($29.99/mo, 1 user). Assigning jobs to team members starts on Pro ($199.99/mo, 4 users), and Google Calendar sync on Beginner ($99.99/mo, 2 users). Route optimization and route density, plus InstaSchedule online booking, are on Elite ($299.99/mo, 10 users) and Max ($699.99/mo, 20 users). Extra users are $25/mo on every plan; yearly billing is 10 months' price for 12. 14-day trial on every plan, but a card is required to start. Details: QuoteIQ review and pricing. {{aff:quoteiq|Try QuoteIQ free for 14 days}}

4. BookingKoala: customers book recurring cleans online

BookingKoala is a booking platform first. Every plan includes a website builder and booking forms with real-time availability, and its features page lists recurring appointments and an accept/decline option so providers confirm jobs. A calendar map view and GPS clock in/out are listed, and SMS notifications start on Growing. Route optimization isn't listed on its pricing page.

Starter from $27/mo (5 providers or 5 GB), Growing from $57/mo (15 providers, adds SMS and GPS clock in/out), Premium from $197/mo (50 providers). No contracts or setup fee; 14-day free trial. Details: BookingKoala pricing and features. {{aff:bookingkoala|Try BookingKoala}}

5. Squeegee: built around window cleaning rounds (GBP pricing)

Squeegee comes from the UK round-based window cleaning world, and its scheduling is built around rounds: group jobs by area, day or team, set the frequency and assign a worker. Its pricing table shows Group Jobs into Rounds, Replan Jobs (shift jobs within a day or move a whole schedule), Assign Work to Users and Teams, Real-time Worker Updates and Optimised Route Navigation (its Day Pilot feature, with a start and end point per worker) on every plan. Appointment reminders and job status notifications are on every plan too. The map-based visual planner and Request Quote in the customer portal are only on Ultimate.

Prices are published in pounds only, per user and plus VAT: Core £19/mo (or £190/yr), Advanced £25/mo (£250/yr), Ultimate £33/mo (£330/yr). Core to Ultimate cap at 10 users; Infinite removes the cap for an added hosting fee. Automated payments run through GoCardless direct debit or a Stripe card on file. Squeegee's home page offers a 30-day free trial. US pricing, US payment support and QuickBooks integration aren't published (unknown), so confirm before switching if you're in the US. Details: Squeegee pricing and features.

Which window cleaning scheduler fits you?

  • Solo, residential, on a budget: QuoteIQ Essentials ($29.99/mo) includes recurring jobs and weather forecasts; Jobber Core ($29/mo billed annually) includes online booking but no routing.
  • Two or more vans: Housecall Pro Essentials ($149/mo annually) includes 5 users and Routes. Jobber's 5-user Connect is $149/mo annually with routing. Compare them in Jobber vs Housecall Pro.
  • You want routes optimized automatically: it's a higher-tier feature almost everywhere: Jobber Connect, Housecall Pro MAX, QuoteIQ Elite. Squeegee is the exception, with optimised route navigation on Core.
  • Customers book themselves: BookingKoala (from $27/mo) or Housecall Pro Basic both include online booking. If customers need an instant price first, add ResponsiBid, which connects to Jobber and Housecall Pro.

faq: What is the cheapest window cleaning scheduling software?

Of the tools we checked on 2026-11-11, BookingKoala Starter starts at $27/mo (booking-first, 5 providers), Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo with no commitment) and QuoteIQ Essentials is $29.99/mo. Squeegee Core is £19/mo per user + VAT, but it publishes pricing in GBP only.
Can window cleaning software repeat jobs every 8 or 12 weeks?

All five tools list recurring jobs or appointments. QuoteIQ includes recurring jobs on every plan, Housecall Pro says visits can repeat weekly, monthly or seasonally, and Squeegee schedules rounds on any frequency. Check custom week intervals in each trial, because not every vendor lists the exact intervals it supports.
Which tool handles rain-day rescheduling best?

Housecall Pro's window cleaning page explicitly lists moving rain-delayed jobs, updating crew assignments and notifying customers. Squeegee lists replanning jobs or shifting a whole schedule on every plan, and QuoteIQ includes built-in weather forecasts on every plan. Jobber offers drag-and-drop rescheduling with push notifications to the crew.
Which plan do I need for route optimization?

Jobber: Connect and up ($99/mo billed annually). Housecall Pro: Routes on Essentials, one-click route optimization on MAX ($299/mo billed annually). QuoteIQ: Elite ($299.99/mo) and Max. Squeegee: optimised route navigation on all plans. BookingKoala doesn't list route optimization.
Do these tools have free trials?

Jobber offers 14 days on Grow and Housecall Pro 14 days on MAX, both with no credit card. QuoteIQ offers 14 days on every plan but needs a card. BookingKoala's pricing page offers a 14-day trial, and Squeegee's home page offers a 30-day free trial.
